skill.name: sales-enablement
skill.description: Creates B2B sales collateral, including pitch decks, one-pagers, objection handling guides, demo scripts, proposals, playbooks, and persona cards.
skill.summary: Create practical sales enablement assets that help reps present value, handle objections, and move deals forward.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

security_audit.summary: All eight static findings are false positives caused by Markdown sales enablement prose and inline file paths. No prompt injection, data exfiltration, command execution, or malicious intent was found in the reviewed context.

static_findings.snippet: **Adjust tone:** Precise, no fluff, respect their expertise. Avoid marketing superlatives.
> "Let me share a quick example. [Customer similar to them] was in a similar situation — [brief chal
- Reference specific things they said (shows you listened)
- This is the asset your champion forwards to their boss
2. **Challenge** — What they were struggling with (2-3 sentences)

finding_verdicts.reason: The line is tone guidance for a technical buyer deck. It does not ask the model to inspect host systems, gather environment data, or perform reconnaissance.
The flagged text warns against overcomplicating an implementation timeline. It is business writing guidance, not network discovery or probing behavior.
The line is a demo talk track placeholder for a customer proof point. It contains no instruction to collect system details or execute system commands.
The text lists data migration as a topic for a technical demo. It does not direct network scanning, enumeration, or access to external systems.
The line advises referencing prospect comments in a follow-up one-pager. It is sales personalization guidance, not system reconnaissance.
The flagged line explains how a champion shares a sales asset internally. It contains no network access, scanning, or discovery instruction.
The word "with" appears inside a case study writing template. It is Markdown prose and not a JavaScript with statement or executable script.
The backticks format Markdown file paths for optional context files. They are not Ruby shell backticks and do not execute external commands.

content.value_statement: Sales teams often need clear assets for each deal stage and buyer role. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code create practical collateral that reps can use quickly.
actual_capabilities: Creates 10 to 12 slide pitch deck outlines with buyer-specific guidance.
Drafts one-pagers, leave-behinds, and champion enablement assets.
Builds objection handling docs using acknowledge, reframe, proof, and question structure.
Designs demo scripts and talk tracks for discovery, technical, and executive calls.
Shapes ROI calculators, proposal templates, case study briefs, and buyer persona cards.
limitations: Requires product, customer, pricing, and proof details for strong output.
Does not verify claims, metrics, logos, or legal language independently.
Does not design finished visual slides or branded layouts by itself.
May need sales leader review before customer-facing use.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Persona-Specific Pitch Deck
use_cases.description: Create a focused sales deck for a technical buyer, economic buyer, champion, or end user.

use_cases.title: Equip Reps With Objection Responses
use_cases.description: Turn common objections into concise talk tracks with proof points and follow-up questions.

use_cases.title: Create Post-Meeting Follow-Up Assets
use_cases.description: Build one-pagers and leave-behinds that summarize pain, value, proof, and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic One-Pager
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple sales asset.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a one-page sales overview for our product. Ask for any missing audience, problem, proof, pricing, or next-step details first.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Sales Deck Outline
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a structured pitch deck.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 10-slide sales deck outline for this buyer persona and deal stage. Include slide goals, key messages, proof points, and speaker notes.

prompt_templates.title: Create Objection Handling Guidance
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an objection handling guide for these five objections. Use acknowledge, reframe, proof, and question sections for each response.

prompt_templates.title: Assemble a Deal-Specific Enablement Pack
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request across multiple sales assets.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a deal-specific enablement pack with deck outline, demo script, ROI message, one-pager, and champion follow-up guidance.

output_examples.input: A sales leader needs a deck for a CFO evaluating a workflow automation platform.
output_examples.output: A concise deck outline covering business pain, cost of inaction, differentiated approach, proof, ROI, timeline, pricing, and next steps.

output_examples.input: An account executive needs help responding to price and timing objections.
output_examples.output: A practical objection guide with short responses, proof points, discovery questions, and cautions for each objection type.

output_examples.input: A founder needs a follow-up asset after a discovery call with a champion.
output_examples.output: A leave-behind structure that restates the problem, desired outcome, recommended solution, proof, and agreed next actions.

best_practices: Provide real buyer context, deal stage, product details, and proof before asking for collateral.
Ask for assets that sales reps can scan during a live call.
Review customer claims, metrics, pricing, and compliance statements before sharing externally.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a generic deck without naming the buyer, problem, and sales stage.
Do not replace customer proof with unsupported claims or vague superlatives.
Do not create long documents when reps need quick answers during calls.

faq.question: What sales assets can this skill create?
faq.answer: It can create decks, one-pagers, objection guides, demo scripts, playbooks, proposals, ROI messages, and persona cards.

faq.question: Does it create finished slide designs?
faq.answer: No. It creates structure, messaging, and guidance that can be moved into a design or presentation tool.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the product, buyer persona, deal stage, sales motion, proof points, pricing context, and current objections.

faq.question: Can it tailor assets for different buyers?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for technical buyers, economic buyers, champions, and other sales personas.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Should outputs be reviewed before use?
faq.answer: Yes. Review claims, metrics, legal statements, pricing, and customer references before sharing with prospects.
